title: Data Migration (localStorage → Filesystem)
description: Implement one-shot migration from localStorage drafts to filesystem-based project structure. Backup localStorage, convert plain-text content to TipTap JSON, create default project from existing conversations.
action: Create desktop/src/services/migrationService.ts with migrateFromLocalStorage() that backs up localStorage, reads all draft entries, creates a default project with chapters, writes chapter files as TipTap JSON, validates each write.

convergence.verification: Migration runs without errors, creates default project with chapters from existing drafts, localStorage backup preserved
convergence.definition_of_done: Migration script executes atomically with rollback on failure, plain text converted to TipTap JSON paragraphs, localStorage kept as fallback

files.change: New service with migrateFromLocalStorage, backupLocalStorage, plainTextToTipTap, validateMigration

implementation: 1. backupLocalStorage(): copy all 'niko.draft:*' entries to 'niko.draft.backup:*' keys
2. getDraftKeys(): scan localStorage for all 'niko.draft:*' keys, extract conversation IDs
3. plainTextToTipTap(text): convert plain text string to TipTap JSONContent { type: 'doc', content: [{ type: 'paragraph', content: [{ type: 'text', text }] }] }

4. migrateFromLocalStorage(): (a) backup localStorage, (b) read all draft entries, (c) create default project 'My Project' via projectFileService, (d) for each draft: create chapter, write TipTap JSON content, (e) validate all files written, (f) write migration flag 'niko.migrated=true', (g) on any failure: log error, keep localStorage data, do not set migration flag
6. validateMigration(projectId, chapterIds): read back each chapter file and verify content matches
test: Test migration with mock localStorage drafts: single draft, multiple drafts, empty drafts, special characters. Test rollback on simulated failure.
rationale: Data loss is the highest risk (L-005). Migration must be atomic, validated, and reversible.
risks: Large number of drafts could cause slow migration — add progress callback
localStorage quota exceeded during backup — check available space first
